observations.text:
Heart Flame

Spend half your current HP. Your next 3 Fire/Heat
damage spells within 5 of your turns gain +100%
base direct damage on every target. One charge per
cast; fully resisted hits still spend it. Utility
and empty casts keep charges but use the time
window. Cooldown 100.

Range: 0 cells.
Targeting: centered on you; area and effects as
described above.
Cooldown: 100 turns after successful use.

Learning: Requires Pyromancy.
Purchase: 1 SP. Available: 0.
Required tree: Pyromancy.

Rite of the Hanging Bolt

Pin one creature (range 6) under a suspended bolt:
2 flat electric damage, and 2 turns of paralysis
per mark consumed. Cooldown 30. Requires grimoire
ink.

Range: 6 cells.
Targeting: first creature along one of eight
directions; solid cover stops the line.
Cost: 1 ink from a carried charged grimoire per
cast.
Spends up to 2 marks per target.
Collateral: creatures in its shape include
companions and neutral creatures.
Next carried book: 10 ink remaining.
Cooldown: 30 turns after successful use.

Learning: Already learned.
Purchase: 1 SP. Available: 0.
Required tree: Rites.

Ready: off cooldown.
Shortcut: 7

Rite of the Hanging Bolt - reading only

Visible candidates only. Unseen interception or
later changes may alter a cast. Reading spends no
ink or turn.

fixture: Ordinary N/Classic start with original stats. Isolated starting zone flattened to floor, player repositioned; stationary actual factory target at east2 with Wet, one granted Hanging Bolt skill and original finite charged grimoire, bounded visibility set. All reader/open/close/navigation/preview/activation inputs use native keyboard; copied text inspection uses public reader paging.
canVerify: Actual X/M/D/P/direction/Escape/Enter input, complete prose, actual range/cooldown/ink and visible mark text, row+scroll restoration, no turn/energy/HP/SP/ink/cooldown/effect/binding changes, unchanged quick-cast direction flow.
cannotVerify: Controlled UI fixture does not prove ordinary rite discovery, enemy choices, balance, novice understanding or visual readability without independent screenshot inspection. Final spell damage is deliberately not predicted. The separate six-case spell benchmark uses direct command/scheduler/save fixtures, not native player input.
